program.name: Upper Lower Four
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Four different days in a row: two upper, two lower, every muscle twice in four days.
program.about: Four different days: two for the upper body, two for the lower. Every muscle trains twice in a cycle, with a different emphasis each time. Upper A leans on presses, upper B on pulls; lower A on squats, lower B on hinges. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Upper A / lower A / upper B / lower B
